Rule: Use product name + product type + visible action or finish + relevant context.
Avoid: Avoid keyword stuffing, claims not visible in image, and subjective superlatives.

Rule: Describe the product name, category, colour/finish and visible packaging details.
Avoid: Do not add flavour unless the image communicates it.

Rule: Describe who or what appears, the routine context, product and visible action.
Avoid: Do not infer identity, emotions or demographics not visible.

Rule: Include product name, shade family, swatch intensity and visible finish.
Recommended Structure: [Product] swatches in [shade family], from sheer to [intensity], [finish]
Avoid: Do not claim exact colour reproduction across screens.

Rule: Name visible ingredient props and connect them to the product only if relevant.
Avoid: Do not imply that the ingredient treats a medical condition.

Rule: Describe product plus visible flavour cue and visual mood.
Avoid: Do not suggest the cosmetic product is food.

Rule: Exclude decorative adjectives, repeated keywords, hidden text, exact hex colours, and promotional urgency.
Avoid: Keep the description useful to someone who cannot see the image.

Rule: Write as a natural description first, then add only the product information needed for context.
Avoid: Do not start with Image of or Picture of unless needed.

Rule: Describe the key visible moment, product and action.
Avoid: Do not describe audio or claims not visible.

Rule: Use one primary product keyword and only relevant secondary descriptors.
Recommended Structure: Product keyword + category + one or two attributes
Avoid: Never repeat the same keyword unnaturally.
